gate.gate-evaluation-note: The W5 delivery environment has no GitHub Actions runner, so the required cohort of >= 5 real-CI four-worker PR runs does not exist; measured workflow p50 is undefined and the activation gate is not evaluable.

contamination-signals-scanned: shared (non-shard-suffixed) artifact/upload names in the workflows job
cache keys without a matrix.shard axis and without restore-keys
overlapping per-worker temp roots / shared mutable output paths
isolation.contamination-canary: tests/test-ci-runtime-contract.rkt — W5 contamination canary case: positive control flags shared output names and shard-less cache keys; negative control requires the live workflows job to be signal-free
isolation.worker-separation: per-worker HOME and workdir separation pins live in tests/test-worker-security.rkt (worker isolation pins); the batch runner resolves --jobs per inner worker
isolation.missing-for-activation: No real-CI four-worker stress cohort exists: zero four-worker PR runs were measured in this delivery environment, so per-run p50, cross-worker contamination observations under load, and cache/artifact isolation behavior on hosted runners are all unobserved; the >= 5-run zero-contamination cohort required by the gate is missing.

nightly.concurrency-cancel: none — nightly runs to completion, queue is cold at start
nightly.runner-contention: low: scheduled off-peak, no PR queue pressure
nightly.timeout-budget: generous job timeout (minutes-scale slack), workflow p50 headroom above the 220 s target
nightly.observed-precedent: W4 measurement (artifacts/ci-topology/v1.00.26-w4/shard-measurement.json): batch-scheduler shard p50s from a cold, uncontended run; the queued variant measured 9-25% above the 5-run batch baseline with unreliable p95

pull-request.concurrency-cancel: in-progress cancellation on new pushes (grouped by ref)
pull-request.runner-contention: high: bursts of concurrent PR runs share hosted-runner capacity; W4's trial window coincided with queue pressure
pull-request.timeout-budget: tighter effective budget: cancelled/superseded runs and queue wait inflate wall-clock p50 even when in-job time is identical
pull-request.observed-precedent: W4 CI measurement on the wave branch (2 queue runs, one 30-minute window) was contention-confounded and not reliable enough to activate queue

nightly-vs-pr-reconciliation.reconciliation: The nightly/PR timeout difference is an environment artifact, not a scheduler property: nightly runs start cold and uncontended with generous timeouts, while PR runs contend with concurrent PR bursts and in-progress cancellation, so identical in-job work shows higher and noisier wall-clock p50s under PR conditions. Because W4's PR-window measurement is contention-confounded and W5 has no real-CI four-worker cohort at all, the 220 s p50 target stays unrevised and is evaluated only against a clean cohort; the guard (WORKFLOW_TEST_JOBS == '4') exists so activation is a one-variable flip once such a cohort is recorded.

decision.reason: The activation gate requires >= 5 real-CI four-worker PR runs with zero contamination and workflow p50 <= 220 s; that cohort does not exist in this delivery environment (0 runs), so the guard holds the worker count at the product default of 2. This is a missing-evidence hold, not a contamination finding: the contamination canary and the guarded seam both pass, and no cross-worker contamination signal was observed.
decision.activation-path: Record a clean >= 5-run real-CI four-worker PR cohort with per-run p50 and zero contamination, confirm workflow p50 <= 220 s with all required checks green, then set the repo variable WORKFLOW_TEST_JOBS=4 — no code change required.
decision.rollback: Leave the repo variable WORKFLOW_TEST_JOBS unset (or set it to anything other than '4'); the guard resolves the worker count to the product default of 2 on the next run — a one-line variable revert.
